properties.title: CaO Abundance · LP GRS 2° (Prettyman et al. 2006)
properties.lri:data_use_note: CaO tracks plagioclase and pyroxene content and correlates with Al2O3 in highland anorthosite.
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.processing:lineage: Column 10 (W_CAO, g/g) of the 2° quasi-equal-area table lpgrs_high1_elem_abundance_2deg.tab (Prettyman et al. 2006) is converted to wt% (×100), then the table rows are written as WKT polygons (longitude bin width varies by latitude to preserve equal area; the two polar caps are half the latitude height of the interior bands). The polygons are rasterized onto a fine 0.1°×0.1° grid, then downsampled with mode resampling to a 1°×1° output grid (half the 2° nominal band height, so the polar caps land exactly on an output pixel edge), then written as a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF.
properties.lri:quality_note_short: Lower precision at 2° for this oxide per Prettyman et al. (2006); prefer 5° or 20°.
properties.lri:quality_note: Derived by linear spectral unmixing of Lunar Prospector gamma ray spectra (Prettyman et al. 2006), calibrated against the feldspathic lunar highlands meteorite composition. Validated against independent neutron-derived macroscopic absorption cross sections (Pearson r = 0.9885) and average atomic mass (Pearson r = 0.944). This dataset passed Planetary Data System peer review. Prettyman et al. (2006) evaluated FeO, TiO2, K, and Th at 2 degree resolution. This parameter was not thoroughly evaluated at 2 degree resolution and has relatively poor precision compared to the 5 and 20 degree products; use the 5 or 20 degree variant where precision matters.
